title: telemetry.configure — OTLP relay configuration (persisted to /etc/falak/telemetry.json, hot reloaded)

endpoint.description: OTLP/HTTP base URL; overrides endpoints.otlp from enrollment

unix_user.description: The unix user a native site runs as (never sent for container runtimes). A native site without a cgroup slice (falak-site_<slug>.slice) is measured by this user's processes: all of them when the site is isolated and no other site claims the user (falak.workload.kind=user); otherwise those attributed to the site, by PHP-FPM pool title (falak-<slug>) else working directory under the sites root (falak.workload.kind=processes). Agents without the telemetry.workloads.shared feature get it for isolated sites only

isolated.description: The site runs as a unix user of its own (feature telemetry.workloads.shared). Only an isolated site is measured by its whole user; a non-isolated site's user is the shared one (also the servers' login user)

runtime.description: The site's runtime: frankenphp, php-fpm, node, bun, deno, static, docker, compose or function. Container runtimes (docker, compose, function) are measured from their labelled containers and need no per-user collector

kind.description: falak.log.kind resource attribute (Loki label falak_log_kind). The edge access logs (/var/log/falak/access/<slug>.log) are always tailed as kind access; they need no entry here

multiline.description: Merge continuation lines into the preceding record. laravel: records start with "[YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" (Monolog line format), so stack traces stay with their error

multiline_pattern.description: Start-of-record regular expression (RE2): a line it matches starts a record, every other line is appended to the record before it. Wins over multiline (feature logs.container_files)

container.description: path is inside the running containers labelled falak.site=<site> (site required; no ".." segment): read through /proc/<container init pid>/root, symlinks resolved inside the container's root, offsets kept per container id. Records carry container.id, container.name, falak.compose.service and falak.log.origin=container_file (feature logs.container_files; agents without it never get such an entry)

compose_service.description: With container: only the containers labelled falak.service=<compose_service> (feature logs.container_files)

origin.description: falak.log.origin record attribute (Loki structured metadata falak_log_origin), the Logs tab's source filter: file, php_fpm (an own PHP-FPM master's error log), php_fpm_slow (a pool's slow log, records at WARN). Container sources are always container_file (feature logs.container_files)

changed.description: true when the host state was modified
